milestone: Reader desktop selection popover geometry proof
scenario: A real Chromium mouse selection near the article top leaves the selection toolbar fully inside the desktop viewport; existing mobile geometry and Agent-drawer contracts remain green.

failure_before_repair.result: No product placement failure was observed. The first test draft used Playwright's nonexistent left/top/right/bottom bounding-box fields; that harness assertion was corrected before counting the geometry result. A separate 901px horizontal drag draft did not create a valid selection and was discarded rather than treated as a product failure.

repair: Added a desktop Chromium mouse-selection geometry assertion at 1280x720 after positioning the first article paragraph near the viewport top.
The assertion checks x/y and width/height bounds for the real selection toolbar; no React or CSS placement change was made because the observed desktop geometry stayed inside the viewport.
Kept the existing mobile 320/375/390/768 geometry checks and Agent drawer selection-context assertions unchanged.

validation.command: cd apps/reader-web && READER_E2E_PORT=3029 PLAYWRIGHT_REUSE_SERVER=false npx playwright test e2e/service-worker.smoke.spec.ts -g 'desktop selection toolbar|mobile selection toolbar stays' --project=chromium

known_limit: This proves desktop Chromium pointer selection and the existing fixture mobile geometry only; it does not prove native iPhone text selection, Firefox/WebKit selection lifecycle, screen-reader semantics, real production viewport/proxy behavior, or a placement implementation change.
